Thank you. So, one thing I always like to hear about is how people kind of got into the kind of work they do today. And so for you, I'm kind of curious, how did you get into this whole like computer thing? Uh, yeah.

So my dad brought home a computer. Someone at work had given him this computer. Uh, he brought it home and uh he plugged it in. He was like really excited about it, but I think he didn't really know much about computers. And one thing he did know is he had learned how to open QBasic. So this was like a DOS-based computer. He opened QBasic. For anyone that doesn't know what QBasic is, it is a basic uh IDE and programming language. and I was like, oh, this is so cool. It's like it knows my name. Uh, how do we how do we stop this thing? Like, you know, I want to write the next program. And he's like, I don't know. I have no idea.
